lead_raw_text:
The structure of RbMg14Ir crystallizes in the hexagonal space group P6_3/mmc (No. 194), with a 32-atom unit cell containing three independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-only CrystalNN analysis shows all three elements in close-packed-like local arrangements: Ir and Rb centers each have 12 Mg neighbors, while Mg centers have 12 neighbors with mixed Mg, Rb, and Ir identities, spanning neighbor distances of 3.1377–3.3696 Å. Validated polyhedron-sharing analysis of the 12-vertex Mg coordination polyhedra reveals corner-, edge-, and face-sharing patterns, and the periodic neighbor graph forms a single 3D-connected component.
